name: 39216 · Jackson, MS
findings: ZIP 39216 (Jackson) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39216 (Jackson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 39216 (Jackson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 12.5 times the typical level).
